Explain why the current through a filament lamp is not proportional to voltage.
questions.a: As current increases the filament heats up (1); resistance increases with temperature (1); so current rises less than in proportion (1)
questions.model: More current, hotter filament. Hotter metal, higher resistance. So the I-V graph curves.
